product_one_liner.value: Obsidian helps enterprise security teams secure SaaS applications, identities, integrations and AI agents through unified visibility, threat detection and least-privilege access enforcement.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes a free starting point and modular expansion.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 269 employees; headcount estimates may lag.

hq_location.notes: Obsidian's August 2026 announcement explicitly identifies Palo Alto, California, as its headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: One qualifying engineer-authored implementation post was verified; a second was not established in the reviewed blog content.

public_docs.notes: Product documentation is portal-gated: the documentation landing page directs users to the book icon inside their Obsidian portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Security Engineer - Taiwan has a live application form.

model_provider.notes: No powering model or provider was explicitly disclosed in the reviewed AI Assistant page and FAQ, related blog post, accessible documentation landing page or trust-center subprocessor listing. Integrations with AI platforms do not establish which models power Obsidian itself.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile records July 22, 2026; Obsidian's announcement is dated August 4, 2026. The value uses the recorded round month rather than the announcement month.

raised_18mo.notes: The $85 million Series D announcement dated August 4, 2026, falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive - San Francisco Bay Area has a live application form.
